title: ComP
description: ComP is a mod that adds many Combat related features to change the flow of battles in Minecraft
body:
# What is it?
ComP, (short for Combat Plus) is a mod that began with a single thought "What if you didn't need a shield to block attacks" and then suddenly everything spiraled from there, ComP is here to do one single job, Make combat in Minecraft more interactive by adding more complex mechanics and foes to face.

# How do I play?
The controls are simple.

- [X] for Guarding, the unarmed version of blocking, it allows you to parry if you time it right leading to a regeneration of posture* and a huge damage boost if you attack soon after parrying.*
- Double tapping [S] to back dash, which allows you to breath when posture is low or when you're in desperate need of some food. this also restores your posture but at a much smaller amount then parrying. (I do not recommend changing this because that might ruin the feel of it)
- [C] for item ability (When it has it)
- [V] for armor-set ability (When it has it)

*posture: your main resource for active abilities abilities and defense.

*2 It is recommend you change the keybind for guarding to something you are more comfortable with.

# Why would YOU want to play this?
I don't really have a good answer for this because it really depends on the player, personally I like how parrying feels, and I also just like how the mod as a whole changes the flow of combat entirely so long as you actively interact with the mods mechanics.

# Perks of being in the discord server:
You get:
- early access to features
- previews of the next full update

I get:
- your feedback
- knowledge of what y'all like
